original.target_description: Study 1, Great Value peanut-butter price-magnitude evaluations: interaction of left-digit difference ($4.01 versus $3.00; $4.00 versus $2.99) and stimulus-based simultaneous versus memory-based sequential presentation, in the two-way between-subjects ANOVA.

es.location: p. 777 (PDF page 7), Table 2, Study 1: Between-Subjects Design, Price-Magnitude Evaluation Study; Left-digit difference × Evaluation mode row
es.quote: Effect                                                                                           df1/df2         F            Effect Size ( Z 2p ) ... Left-digit difference  Evaluation mode                                                           1/141         4.84                 .033

notes: Only es_value_o is assigned; all other value fields are unassigned placeholders. Both assigned descriptions explicitly identify the same original Study 1 factorial interaction, irrespective of the different replication labels. Table 2 prints partial eta-squared .033, not standardized beta; metric identity was checked on rendered PDF page 7. Study 1 Results (p. 776) reports the same interaction F(1, 141) = 4.84, p = .029; simple contrasts are distinct tests (stimulus-based F = 8.08; memory-based F = .08) and were not substituted. No effect-size conversion or N derivation performed.
